final: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / l.GPT) AS mean_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX <> '' GROUP BY p.SEX), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(mean_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM sex_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT s.sex, s.mean_ratio, s.mean_ratio - o.mean_ratio AS difference FROM sex_averages AS s CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND s.mean_ratio > o.mean_ratio), above_overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(mean_ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM above_overall) SELECT AVG(a.mean_ratio), AVG(a.difference), AVG(a.mean_ratio - b.mean_ratio) FROM above_overall AS a CROSS JOIN above_overall_average AS b WHERE b.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND a.mean_ratio > b.mean_ratio
